verse.name: v1a
verse.lines:
I give You glory
For all You've brought me through
And now I'm ready
For whatever You want to do

verse.name: v1b
verse.lines:
I'm moving forward
To follow after You
And now I'm ready
For whatever You want to do

verse.name: c1a
verse.lines:
Your presence
Is an open door
We want You Lord like never before

verse.name: c1b
verse.lines:
Your presence
Is an open door
So come now Lord, like never before

verse.name: v2a
verse.lines:
In every season
Your grace has been enough
And I'm believing
The best is yet to come

verse.name: v2b
verse.lines:
The cross before me
My hope on things above
And in You Jesus
The best is yet to come

verse.name: b1
verse.lines:
I know breakthrough is coming
By faith I see a miracle
My God made me a promise
And it won't stop now
